```{r}
## Write to fasta for clustering in MMseqs2
write_fasta <- function(df, seq_col, id_col,file_out){
  seqinr::write.fasta(sequences = as.list(df[[seq_col]]), names = df[[id_col]], file.out = file_out)
}
```

## Load Data

### Load database

```{r}
db <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/clean_results/19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')

db$f <- rep("19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv", each = nrow(db))

# Trim CDR3s
db$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(db$junction_aa)

# Translate
db$VHH <- translate_DNA(db$sequence_alignment)

# Trim
db$VHH <- substr(db$VHH, 11, nchar(db$VHH))

# Keep productive only
nrow(db)
db <- unproductive(db)
nrow(db)

db <- db[,c("sequence_id",
            "v_call",
            "d_call",
            "j_call",
            "junction_aa",
            "duplicate_count",
            "clone_id",
            "f",
            "VHH")]
```

```{r}
tmp <- read.csv("~/Downloads/S19-Deduplicated-Clone-49-24Mar24-H95_cluster.tsv", header = F, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')
# Assign Variable Names
colnames(tmp) <- c("centroid", "sequence_id")
# Create a centroid id
tmp$centroid_id <- as.numeric(factor(tmp$centroid))
```

The goal here is to have sub-families within clonal families, where each sub-family is clustered by homology to within 95%, and all sub-families are averaged by percent homology to the median CDR3 in the entire family.

This creates a nice mathematical object with strong statistical properties, as each clonal family has "children" clustered within range to multiple centroids.

## Merge Frames

### Pre-Merge Cleaning

```{r}
clean_seq_ids <- function(seq_col){
  seq_col <- gsub(":", '', seq_col)
  #db[[seq_col]] <- gsub("-", '', db[[seq_col]])
  return(seq_col)
}
```

```{r}
db$sequence_id <- clean_seq_ids(db$sequence_id)
tmp$centroid <- clean_seq_ids(tmp$centroid)
tmp$sequence_id <- clean_seq_ids(tmp$sequence_id)
```

### Merge on sequence ID to find 

```{r}
merge_db_to_centroids <- function(db, tmp){
  dat <- merge(db, tmp, by = "sequence_id")
  # Pull out data and prepare to change column names for ease
  tmp <- dat[,c("sequence_id", "centroid")]
  # Update column names of tmp
  colnames(tmp) <- c("tmp_sequence_id", "sequence_id")
  # Join for Centroid sequences
  tmp <- merge(tmp, dat[,c("sequence_id", "VHH")], by = "sequence_id")
  # Correct column names
  colnames(tmp) <- c("centroid_sequence_id", "sequence_id", "centroid")
  # Remove "centroid" from dat
  dat$centroid <- NULL
  # Final merge
  dat <- merge(dat, tmp, by = "sequence_id")
  return(dat)
}

dat <- merge_db_to_centroids(db, tmp)

# Drop centroid sequence id for now
dat$centroid_sequence_id <- NULL

rm(db, tmp)
```

## Calculate Family-based statistics

```{r}
# Unroll
unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(dat, "VHH")
unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(dat, "junction_aa")

# Pull statistics
median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)

# Distance from median
dat$family_median_VHH_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(median_VHH, dat$VHH))/nchar(median_VHH))*100

dat$family_median_CDR3_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(median_CDR3, dat$junction_aa))/nchar(median_CDR3))*100

dat$family_consensus_CDR3_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(consensus_CDR3, dat$junction_aa))/nchar(consensus_CDR3))*100
```

## Calculate sub-family-based statistics

```{r}
results <- data.frame()

# For each centroid id
for (nm in unique(dat$centroid_id)){
  cat(nm, '\n')
  tmp_frame <- dat[dat$centroid_id == nm,]
  
  # Unroll
  unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
  
  # Pull statistics
  median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
  median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
  consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
    
  # Distance from median
  tmp_frame$subfamily_median_VHH_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(median_VHH, tmp_frame$VHH))/nchar(median_VHH))*100
  
  tmp_frame$subfamily_median_CDR3_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(median_CDR3, tmp_frame$junction_aa))/nchar(median_CDR3))*100
  
  tmp_frame$subfamily_consensus_CDR3_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(consensus_CDR3, tmp_frame$junction_aa))/nchar(consensus_CDR3))*100
  
  results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
}
```


1. Create logo plots for entire family, 

2. Create logo plots for each sub family 

sorted by VHH percent homology to the median centroid in the Hierarchical cluster
